remarks: mahadish.in is not a .gov.in domain, but it is the de facto official Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) Maharashtra website: it is linked directly from the official Labour Commissioner site mahakamgar.maharashtra.gov.in, carries an official @gov.in contact email (dirdish.mum-mh@gov.in), displays the Government of India/Maharashtra state emblem, and its content (forms, gazette PDFs, procedures) is internally consistent and cites real official notification numbers/dates. Treated as a verified government source for this reason.

The actual transactional application portal for Maharashtra factory licensing (lms.mahaonline.gov.in, reached via the MAITRI single-window login) could not be fetched from this session despite being the portal DISH's own procedure pages instruct applicants to use — likely a server-side TLS/availability issue rather than content absence; excluded per the spec's rule rather than assumed working.

www.nsws.gov.in required following an http->https redirect to resolve (curl's initial attempt to the bare host alone timed out quickly before -L followed the redirect to www.nsws.gov.in:443, which returned HTTP 200).

This environment's egress proxy showed many other Indian state-government hosts failing for other concurrent sessions during this work (per /__agentproxy/status); none of those unrelated hosts were used as MH candidates here, but it indicates these .gov.in/.nic.in sites are broadly flaky to reach from this network path, not unique to Maharashtra.
